\viewkind4\uc1\pard\kerning2\i\f0\fs22 Roundhouse Aquarium Board Member John Roberts announced a free public lecture, "Hope on the Horizon" by Marine Mammal Care Center Chief Operations and Education Officer, David Bader which will be held on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM, at the Manhattan Beach Public Library.\par
\par
Founder and Director of Single Mom Project Janet Jones announced that Tuesday, September 8, 2026, is Single Mom Project \f1 Day in Manhattan Beach.\f2\fs21\line\line\f0\fs22 Waste Management Recycling Education Representative Bobby Bell announced that Waste Management handed out lunch boxes to incoming Kindergartners at Pacific Elementary School on August 13, 2026, and Grand View Elementary School on August 16, 2026. He provided there were three more elementary schools to go.\par
\par
Manhattan Beach 10K Run Founder Russ Lesser announced the 49th Annual run will be held on October 3, 2026. He provided if anyone is interested in participating, visit www.mb10k.com to register.\par
\par
Councilmember Howorth announced that Manhattan Beach public schools are back to school on August 19, 2026. and provided general safety reminders.\par
